description: Defines a PHP class 'DetailedTimesheet' in the namespace 'OrangeHRM\Time\Dto', representing a detailed view of a timesheet with properties for the timesheet data, rows, and columns, along with corresponding accessor methods.

classes.name: DetailedTimesheet
classes.description: A data transfer object encapsulating detailed timesheet information, including the timesheet entity, rows, and columns arrays.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializes the DetailedTimesheet with a Timesheet object, and arrays of rows and columns.

methods.name: getTimesheet
methods.description: Returns the Timesheet object associated with this detailed timesheet.

methods.name: getRows
methods.description: Returns the array of TimesheetRow objects associated with this timesheet.

methods.name: getColumns
methods.description: Returns the array of TimesheetColumn objects associated with this timesheet.
